Includes all new features and bug fixes up to Obsidian Desktop v1.14.4.

Quick Capture on iOS

On iOS 26, Quick Capture lets you instantly create notes from the Lock Screen, Control Center, Home Screen widgets, or Shortcuts without waiting for your vault to load.

  • Customize Locations to capture to a new note, today’s daily note, a bookmarked note, or any note you choose, with optional templates.

Improvements

  • Text and interface elements now scale with your system’s preferred text size, including larger accessibility sizes.
  • Right-to-left (RTL) languages: Swipe gestures and page animations are now flipped.
  • Settings now open in a sheet over the app. Swipe anywhere to dismiss.
  • iOS: Added support for the new extra large widgets in iOS 27 for View Note and Quick Capture.
  • iOS: Share Sheet now uses the vault accent color.
  • Android: The Open Note widget now displays the name of the note.
  • Android: The “Insert attachment” mobile toolbar button now allows taking a photo directly.

Bases

  • Revised the toolbar layout. The new Group menu is available inside the Display toolbar menu.
  • Opening the view configuration page no longer automatically focuses the view name.
  • The “Add view” command now automatically focuses the view name input.

No longer broken

  • Fixed “Setup Obsidian Sync” on the vault chooser screen loading forever after your login expired.
  • The Configure toolbar button now takes you directly to the mobile toolbar settings page (previously it took you to “Interface”).
  • Fixed Hotkeys settings overflowing and causing the page to scroll horizontally.
  • Fixed missing close animation when tapping the “x” button in the command palette.
  • Fixed the vault switcher not always showing a dark keyboard.
  • Bases: Fixed exporting a view as a CSV file.
  • Bases: Fixed table view losing its horizontal scroll position when the pull-down action is triggered.
  • iOS: Fixed syllables sometimes disappearing while typing in Korean.
  • iOS: Fixed the Share Sheet generating invalid filenames for Instagram posts.
  • iOS: Fixed the progress bar briefly flashing during startup.
  • iPad: Fixed incorrect app and status bar sizing when resizing windows in Split View or Stage Manager.
  • Android: Fixed the splash screen rendering incorrectly.

Developers

  • Use --font-preferred-size for text that should respect the system’s preferred text size. On mobile, it combines --font-text-size with the --preferred-text-scale multiplier.

This update introduces support for opening individual Markdown files, a kanban view for Bases, and highlight colors.

Important: opening Markdown files requires the latest installer. Download Obsidian from our website and reinstall the app.

While you’re here… Tell us about your favorite plugins, themes, tools, and ways to use Obsidian: take the State of Obsidian 2026 survey.

Open individual Markdown files

You can now open individual Markdown files from outside your vault in Obsidian, and preview them on macOS using Quick Look. Files open in your current window.

  • Added the “Open file from outside the vault…” command. Pick a Markdown file on your computer and view it in the app.
  • Obsidian now appears in your operating system’s Open with menu, and you can set it as the default app for Markdown files.
  • On macOS you can use Quick Look previews for Markdown files even when Obsidian is closed.
  • Added document icons on macOS and Windows for .md, .base and .canvas.
  • Image embeds and links to other local files resolve relative to the Markdown file’s folder.
  • Use Outline to navigate headings and Outgoing links to browse linked files.

Kanban view and group options for Bases

Bases now has a kanban view. Organize your notes into columns and drag cards between groups. You can also reorder and hide groups in any Bases view using the new Group menu.

  • Use the Group menu to choose a grouping property and reorder, hide, or add groups.
  • Groups are now collapsible in the table, cards, and list layouts.

Highlight colors

Bring color to your notes with six highlight colors.

  • Add a color emoji (🔴, 🟠, 🟡, 🟢, 🔵, 🟣) at the start of a highlight, or choose a color from the formatting menu.
  • Typing == in the editor now suggests highlight colors.
  • Live Preview: When the cursor overlaps a highlight, an inline swatch now appears. Click it to quickly change the highlight color.

Improvements

  • Improved fuzzy search in the quick switcher and suggestions. Matches where your letters start words now rank higher.
  • Link suggestions and the quick switcher now use fuzzy matching in vaults of any size.
  • Improved search in the File Explorer, Bookmarks, Outline, Tags, and Sync views. Search now matches the full path of each item, and everything inside a matching item stays visible. Groups with nothing to show are hidden.
  • Excluding a search term (e.g. -Archive) in the File Explorer, Bookmarks, Outline, and Sync views now hides a matching folder and everything inside it.
  • Improved drag and drop in the File Explorer. The view now smoothly scrolls when dragging near the edge.
  • The entire workspace, including the sidebars, now flips when Obsidian is set to a right-to-left (RTL) language. Commands stay the same, so “Toggle left sidebar” now refers to the visual left sidebar, even when the interface is flipped.
  • Redesigned the empty state and added “New base” and “New canvas” when their plugins are enabled.
  • Added “Increase font size” and “Decrease font size” commands.
  • Base font size is now saved per device and no longer syncs through Obsidian Sync.
  • Added an update notice in Settings → General when a newer installer is available.
  • All in-app links now take you to the localized version of the Obsidian website.
  • When opening an untrusted vault, themes and snippets are temporarily disabled while the “Do you trust the author of this vault” dialog is on screen.
  • Format converter: Removed old formats from the converter plugin.

Performance

  • Fixed periodic input lag in large vaults caused by properties getting recomputed in the background.
  • Fixed the app freezing when searching headings across all notes ([[##) in large vaults.
  • Fuzzy search in the quick switcher and suggestions is now faster in large vaults.
  • Closing popout windows (such as Settings) is now much faster.

Bases

  • Added right-to-left (RTL) support to table views, including keyboard navigation, selections, and horizontal scrolling.
  • Improved how dates and times are rendered in group headers and in read-only layouts (e.g. Cards, Kanban).
  • A base made with “Create new base” now names its first view “View” instead of “Table”.

Editor

  • Pasting a list item onto a line that already contains a list marker (e.g. - [ ] ) no longer duplicates the marker.
  • In Source mode, pressing ↑ on the first line of a note now moves the cursor to the inline title, like in Live Preview.
  • Improved the inline formatting commands. For example, “Toggle bold” on this line:
    some **bold |text** on the line|
    now results in:
    some **bold text on the line**

No longer broken

  • Fixed copy and paste not working correctly in popout windows, including copying and pasting notes in Canvas.
  • Fixed property suggestions sometimes showing results for an earlier query, which made Enter pick an old link instead of what you typed.
  • Fixed pressing Enter on an invalid title in an embedded note (e.g. a new note from Bases) reverting the title and moving focus out of it. The title now stays focused so you can fix the name.
  • Fixed tooltips briefly disappearing when moving between adjacent items.
  • Fixed page preview showing behind Bases toolbar menus.
  • Fixed a potential iframe injection in the Slides plugin.
  • Fixed incorrect language code used for Khmer.
  • Web viewer: Fixed Google sign-in failing.
  • Note composer: Fixed “Extract this heading” not preserving the newline when there is only one newline between the section and the next heading.
  • Canvas: Fixed a card narrowed to a heading or block still showing that section after using Swap file… to pick the same file.
  • Vim: Fixed deleting and pasting a numbered list item inserting blank lines and empty numbered items.

Bases

  • Fixed the “+” button not generating correct frontmatter for unresolved links, e.g. file.hasLink("[[unresolved]]").
  • Fixed a long property name in a filter rule pushing the operator and value out of view.
  • Fixed “Hide all” causing the properties menu to render incorrectly.
  • Fixed “Copy path” showing up below “Delete” when you right-click a file in a table or cards view.

Editor

  • Fixed Option-Shift-↑ and Option-Shift-↓ not working consistently on macOS in long paragraphs, where the scroll position would sometimes reset and the text selection would be incorrect.
  • Fixed incorrect cursor placement when moving the cursor to the end of the line with multiple formatting markers (e.g. **__text__**).
  • Fixed ↑ not moving from the editor to the inline title when there are no properties.
  • Fixed Home and End keys in right-to-left languages.
  • Fixed a parser issue where ![]( caused all following text in the document to be treated as part of the image.
  • Fixed Markdown formatting characters not parsing correctly around emails (e.g. *Some email: random@example.com*).
  • Fixed clicking on collapsed reference links (e.g. [link][]) going to the wrong destination.

Third-party libraries

  • Math rendering now uses MathJax 4.1.3, replacing MathJax 3.

Developers

  • The installer has been updated to use Electron v43.7.5. To upgrade, visit the Obsidian download page and reinstall Obsidian.
  • Editor: Each line of a math block ($$) now has the .HyperMD-math class.
  • Settings: Added optional SettingDefinitionItem#id for setting a unique ID on individual settings. Think of it like <div key={key} /> in React. Use it to differentiate between sibling settings that share a name, or to keep a stable reference when a setting or setting page is renamed.
  • Added CSS variables for tooltips, notices, hotkeys, and tabs, using the prefixes --tooltip-, --notice-, --hotkey, --tab-inner- and --tab-container-.

Improvements

  • Live Preview: Restored old behavior of embedded YouTube and Twitter links; they no longer have a selection state or an overlayed edit button.

Compatibility with latest installer

  • Fixed zoom level getting reset after reloading the window.
  • Fixed vaults on network drives not working.
  • Fixed devtools not opening correctly when using the Web viewer plugin.

This update introduces a new searchable Settings panel and iOS Share Sheet. Scrolling large files and selecting text should also be improved on both iOS and Android. Includes all new features and bug fixes up to Obsidian Desktop v1.13.4.

iOS Share Sheet

The new iOS Share Sheet lets you save content from Safari, YouTube, and other apps without opening Obsidian. You can customize several Locations to define the vault, folder, and template that is used. Learn more.

This update introduces a new searchable Settings panel and new experience for working with images, including a full-screen image viewer.

Settings

Settings have been completely revamped with keyboard navigation, search, and new APIs for plugin developers.

  • Settings now open in a new window. You can turn this off in Settings → Interface → Open settings in new window.
  • Added search. You can now search for settings by name or description. This currently supports core settings and core plugins. Community plugins can migrate to the new settings API to appear in search results.
  • Added keyboard navigation. Use arrow keys to move between items, Enter to open a setting tab, and Ctrl/Cmd-F to re-focus search. Also supports Vim key bindings.
  • Some settings have moved into a new Interface settings page. Several settings pages have been redesigned to improve navigation.
  • Added the ability to exit Restricted Mode without re-enabling your plugins. Useful for debugging your vault.
  • Deprecated the Settings Search plugin as it overlaps with the new search functionality. Thank you to javalent for such a great plugin! It has been added to the Obsidian credits page.

Images

Image are now easier to resize and can be viewed fullscreen. Click an image or the Zoom button to open it. You can navigate between all the images embedded in the current file, and click and drag to pan within an image.

  • Live Preview: New editor experience when working with images. Images can now be selected via the keyboard, and they don’t automatically expand to reveal their filename. When the image is selected, backspace and delete will remove the embedded image, and Ctrl/Cmd-C and Ctrl/Cmd-X will copy or cut the image.
  • Live Preview: Added keyboard interactions when an image is selected. Press + or - to resize the selected image, and 0 to reset the image size. Press Enter to edit the image, or Tab to manually edit the image size.
  • Vim: Added a new :image Ex command to interact with the selected image. Use :image grow and :image shrink to resize the image, and :image reset to reset the image size. It also supports a count, so :5image grow will grow the image 5 times.

Improvements

Security

  • Obsidian URIs now present a confirmation dialog before firing the action. Choose “Don’t ask again” to add that action to an allow list. Manage the allow list from settings.
  • Added a warning before attempting to load HTML resources if the source points to a network drive.
  • Added a warning dialog when choosing to sync plugins via Obsidian Sync.

Editor

  • Reading mode now supports external images with an image size and no alt text (e.g. ![200](https://www.path.to/image.png)).
  • Note Composer: When extracting a section from a file, links in that section will now be rewritten to be relative to the new location.

File explorer

  • Pressing Escape to cancel the file rename keeps the File Explorer focused.
  • Pressing Escape clears the current selection.
  • “Auto reveal” will no longer activate when renaming a file or folder.
  • Added support for dragging links from a Base into the File Explorer to move the file to a new location.
  • Minor improvements to drag and drop behavior.

Properties

  • Improved keyboard navigation in the Global Properties view; Backspace now deletes the selected properties.
  • Improved the property type menu to make it clearer whether a property’s type is set automatically or chosen manually.

Obsidian Sync

  • Removed spinning from the status bar icon because it impacted battery life when the app idles.
  • Files in the Sync sidebar view now show all file-related items in the context menu.
  • Files in the Sync sidebar view can now be dragged into other views or into the editor.

Developers

  • The installer has been updated to use Electron v39.7.0 (requires downloading the latest installer).
  • We’ve updated how our translation files are created and bundled with the app. For translators, see the updated instructions on our translations repository.
  • Added theming support for corner shapes using corner-shape CSS property. Replaced -electron-corner-smoothing. Requires Chromium 139 and Obsidian 1.11+.
  • macOS: New traffic-lights-offset-x and --traffic-lights-offset-y CSS variables to configure where the traffic lights appear in the window frame. These offsets are now applied immediately when the app loads.
  • We’ve introduced a breaking API change to BaseOption#shouldHide. This function no longer receives the config as an argument. Options should be accessed from BasesViewRegistration.options instead.
registerView('my-view-id', {
		name: 'View Name',
		icon: 'my-icon',
		factory: () => new MyView(),
		options: (config: BasesViewConfig) => ({
			// Here ^
		})
});

Improvements

CLI

  • Added help <command> to get help with a specific command.
  • Added --help as an alias for the help command.
  • Added daily:path command to get the expected daily note path.
  • Added rename command.
  • Split the search command into search and search:context.
  • Added descriptions to filter parameters in help output.
  • CLI commands now default to silent operation and doesn’t expect an active file by default.
    • the all parameter has been replaced by active (to target active file)
    • the silent parameter has been replaced by open to open the target
  • The CLI now ignores unrecognized flags starting with --.
  • Changed the CLI setup cancel button to say “Skip” to indicate the step is optional.

Bases

  • Added the ability to import files into Bases via drag and drop.
  • file.linksTo() treats files embedded within a Canvas as links.
